entries.title: Psalms 74:1
segments: <<Maschil of Asaph.>> O God, why hast thou cast [us] off for ever? Why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

entries.title: Psalms 74:2
segments: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast gotten of old, Which thou hast redeemed to be the tribe of thine inheritance; [And] mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

entries.title: Psalms 74:3
segments: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual ruins, All the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 74:4
segments: Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of thine assembly; They have set up their ensigns for signs.

entries.title: Psalms 74:5
segments: They seemed as men that lifted up Axes upon a thicket of trees.

entries.title: Psalms 74:6
segments: And now all the carved work thereof They break down with hatchet and hammers.

entries.title: Psalms 74:7
segments: They have set thy sanctuary on fire; They have profaned the dwelling-place of thy name [by casting it] to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 74:8
segments: They said in their heart, Let us make havoc of them altogether: They have burned up all the  synagogues of God in the land.

entries.title: Psalms 74:9
segments: We see not our signs: There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

entries.title: Psalms 74:10
segments: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

entries.title: Psalms 74:11
segments: Why drawest thou back thy hand, even thy right hand? [Pluck it] out of thy bosom [and] consume [them].

entries.title: Psalms 74:12
segments: Yet God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 74:13
segments: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: Thou brakest the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.

entries.title: Psalms 74:14
segments: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces; Thou gavest him to be food to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 74:15
segments: Thou didst cleave fountain and flood: Thou driedst up mighty rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 74:16
segments: The day is thine, the night also is thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

entries.title: Psalms 74:17
segments: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.

entries.title: Psalms 74:18
segments: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Jehovah, And that a foolish people hath blasphemed thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 74:19
segments: Oh deliver not the soul of thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast: Forget not the life of thy poor for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 74:20
segments: Have respect unto the covenant; For the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of violence.

entries.title: Psalms 74:21
segments: Oh let not the oppressed return ashamed: Let the poor and needy praise thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 74:22
segments: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: Remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 74:23
segments: Forget not the voice of thine adversaries: The tumult of those that rise up against thee ascendeth continually.
